description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ArtifactInfoBase' used for representing artifacts in the OFBiz webtools framework. It provides method signatures for retrieving display names, types, location URLs, unique IDs, and implements comparison and equality logic.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoBase
classes.description: An abstract base class representing artifact information within the webtools framework, providing common attributes and method signatures for subclasses.

methods.name: ArtifactInfoBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ArtifactInfoBase with a given ArtifactInfoFactory.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this artifact with another based on their string representations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on string representation.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the display name of the artifact.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the display type of the artifact.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the URL location of the artifact; may throw MalformedURLException.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the type of the artifact.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a unique identifier for the artifact.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string combining display type and display name; caches the result.
